name: Guzman y Gomez - Chatswood
reviews:
I have been their customer for many years. They have been usually good.

Today, they messed up in so many ways.

Date: 03-July’26
Order number: 2127
Order: Burrito bowl with veggies.
Issues:
1. Piece of meat
2. Avocado peel
3. Raw avocado slice
4. Mushroom stem

Signs of zero care for customers and ignorance.

I’m not sure if they even care about customers anymore considering all of this happened in one order.

GYG is usually a good choice. My visit was however a flop. The staff had to ask me if I want chicken or tender even after I clearly said I want chicken tender. The order waited on the counter a bit because I could not hear them call while sitting outside. I just go check. No problems right? The staff said “I called before.” Excuse me, did I blame you? I just asked nicely if my order is good to go. In the end, the chips in my cali burrito was cold. It was not very pleasant to eat.

Longtime fan of GYG, this is a great location in the heart of Chatswood, right next to the grassy lawn across from the library. Always super quick service, delicious food, my only note would be that sometimes the tacos and burritos are generously filled and other times it is under filled.

Ordered a burrito bowl and paid extra for guac. Then I found half an unripe avocado in my burrito bowl. Not guac, half a full avocado. Charged me extra for this? Other than this, not much issues with this GYG, come here multiple times and is usually good.
This is by far the best GYG in town! Always give me the freshest food, smiley service and big space! I always come here to have my pre or post workout meals. Love your work guys!
